newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR SLIPS WITH NY, SOME SUPPORT SEEN.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR SLIPS WITH NY, SOME SUPPORT SEEN.

text.p: White sugar futures adopted some of the bearish sentiment from the New York market but benchmark October still tried to cling to $323 despite breaching nearby support, traders said on Friday.

Turnover picked up in the afternoon although some of this was composed by crossed trades and spread activity was subdued. But the Oct/Oct arbitrage widened as London failed to keep pace with New York's fall.
Bargain-hunters at the lows also kept October from falling too far, traders said.
At 1450 GMT October was down $1.20 at an intraday low of $322.00 and December down 70 cents at $319.50. Volume was 2,006 lots.
Technical analysts said October looked poised to test support $321.70 followed by $320 once $323.00 was broken.
Only the two nearby contracts were traded in Paris with just 210 lots on the board.
October was down 70 cents at $322.50 and December down 30 cents at $319.90.
